title: Colours
description: Describe and choose things by colour.

questions.sentence: Aakash no rang kayo che?
options: Aakash nilu che.
Aakash pilu che.
Aakash bahu duur che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aakash nilu che.
questions.translatedSentence: The sky is blue.

questions.sentence: Dudh dholu che.
options: The milk is white.
The milk is hot.
The milk is finished.
questions.correctAnswer: The milk is white.

questions.sentence: Tamne kayo rang game che?
options: Mane nilo rang game che.
Mane aa rang nathi gamto.
Mane pila phool game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane nilo rang game che.
questions.translatedSentence: I like blue.

questions.sentence: Mane kalo rang bahu game che.
options: I like black a lot.
I do not like black at all.
I want the black one.
questions.correctAnswer: I like black a lot.

questions.sentence: Aa kelu kaya rang nu che?
options: Aa kelu pilu che.
Aa kelu lilu che.
Aa kelu mithu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa kelu pilu che.
questions.translatedSentence: This banana is yellow.

questions.sentence: Aa phool gulabi che.
options: This flower is pink.
This flower is fresh.
This flower is for you.
questions.correctAnswer: This flower is pink.

questions.sentence: Tamari gaadi kaya rang ni che?
options: Mari gaadi dholi che.
Mari gaadi navi che.
Mari gaadi ghare che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mari gaadi dholi che.
questions.translatedSentence: My car is white.

questions.sentence: Kagdo kalo hoy che.
options: A crow is black.
A crow is noisy.
A crow is sitting there.
questions.correctAnswer: A crow is black.

questions.sentence: Tametu lal che ke naarangi?
options: Tametu lal che.
Tametu naarangi che.
Tametu bahu mongu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Tametu lal che.
questions.translatedSentence: The tomato is red.

questions.sentence: Aa chopdi kaya rang ni che?
options: Aa chopdi lili che.
Aa chopdi jaadi che.
Aa chopdi mari nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa chopdi lili che.
questions.translatedSentence: This book is green.

questions.sentence: Mara ghar no darwajo bhuro che.
options: The door of my house is brown.
The door of my house is open.
My house has a big door.
questions.correctAnswer: The door of my house is brown.

questions.sentence: Pelo thelo kaya rang no che?
options: Pelo thelo kalo che.
Pelo thelo bhaare che.
Pelo thelo mari bahen no che.
questions.correctAnswer: Pelo thelo kalo che.
questions.translatedSentence: That bag is black.

questions.sentence: Amara ghar ni bhint dholi che.
options: The wall of our house is white.
The wall of our house is dirty.
Our house has a high wall.
questions.correctAnswer: The wall of our house is white.

questions.sentence: Tamaro rumal kayo che?
options: Pelo pilo rumal maro che.
Maro rumal ghare rahi gayo che.
Mane navo rumal joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Pelo pilo rumal maro che.
questions.translatedSentence: That yellow handkerchief is mine.

questions.sentence: Tamari pen nili che ke kali?
options: Is your pen blue or black?
Do you have a blue pen?
Is this black pen yours?
questions.correctAnswer: Is your pen blue or black?

questions.sentence: Dhokla kaya rang na hoy che?
options: Dhokla pila hoy che.
Dhokla lila hoy che.
Dhokla bahu tikha hoy che.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhokla pila hoy che.
questions.translatedSentence: Dhokla are yellow.

questions.sentence: Chaas dholi hoy che ane thandi hoy che.
options: Buttermilk is white and it is cold.
Buttermilk is white and it is sweet.
Buttermilk is cold but it is thick.
questions.correctAnswer: Buttermilk is white and it is cold.

questions.sentence: Tamaru ghar kaya rang nu che?
options: Amaru ghar dholu che.
Amaru ghar bahu motu che.
Amaru ghar Ahmedabad ma che.
questions.correctAnswer: Amaru ghar dholu che.
questions.translatedSentence: Our house is white.

questions.sentence: Tamne kayo rang joie che?
options: Mane nilo rang joie che.
Mane aa dukan bahu game che.
Mane be chopdi joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane nilo rang joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: I want the blue one.

questions.sentence: Mane lal rang nathi joito, mane kalo joie che.
options: I do not want red, I want black.
I do not like red, I like black.
I want red, not black.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not want red, I want black.

questions.sentence: Tamari pase aa kurto bija rang ma che?
options: Ha, aa kurto gulabi ma pan che.
Ha, aa kurto bahu sasto che.
Na, mane aa kurto nathi gamto.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, aa kurto gulabi ma pan che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have this kurta in pink as well.

questions.sentence: Mane naarangi rang no dupatto batavo.
options: Please show me an orange dupatta.
I bought an orange dupatta.
This orange dupatta is mine.
questions.correctAnswer: Please show me an orange dupatta.

questions.sentence: Tamne pilo game ke gulabi?
options: Mane gulabi vadhare game che.
Mane banne rang joie che.
Mane lilu shaak vadhare game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane gulabi vadhare game che.
questions.translatedSentence: I like pink better.

questions.sentence: Aa rang mane nathi gamto, biju kaik batavo.
options: I do not like this colour, please show me something else.
I like this colour, please show me one more.
This colour is not available, show me another shop.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like this colour, please show me something else.

questions.sentence: Aa jaambli sadi tamne kevi lage che?
options: Mane bahu saras lage che.
Mane bahu bhookh lagi che.
Mare sadi pahervi nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane bahu saras lage che.
questions.translatedSentence: I think it looks very nice.

questions.sentence: Mari dikri mate lilo chaniyo joie che.
options: I need a green skirt for my daughter.
My daughter does not like green.
My daughter is wearing a green skirt.
questions.correctAnswer: I need a green skirt for my daughter.

questions.sentence: Aa sadi ketla rango ma male che?
options: Aa sadi char rango ma male che.
Aa sadi bahu mongi che.
Mane traan sadi joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa sadi char rango ma male che.
questions.translatedSentence: This saree comes in four colours.

questions.sentence: Tame kaya rang no jhabbho paheryo che?
options: Me dholo jhabbho paheryo che.
Maro jhabbho bahu juno che.
Maro jhabbho dhovai gayo che.
questions.correctAnswer: Me dholo jhabbho paheryo che.
questions.translatedSentence: I am wearing a white kurta.

questions.sentence: Aaje me lilo chaniyo ane lal dupatto paheryo che.
options: Today I am wearing a green skirt and a red dupatta.
Today I bought a green skirt and a red dupatta.
Today my green skirt and my red dupatta are ready.
questions.correctAnswer: Today I am wearing a green skirt and a red dupatta.

questions.sentence: Garba mate tame kaya rang na kapda paheresho?
options: Hu naarangi kapda paheris.
Mane garba bahu game che.
Hu garba ma modu javano chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu naarangi kapda paheris.
questions.translatedSentence: I will wear orange clothes.

questions.sentence: Mara bhai ne dholo jhabbho bahu game che.
options: My brother really likes the white kurta.
My brother is wearing the white kurta.
My brother bought a white kurta.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother really likes the white kurta.

questions.sentence: Tara juta kaya rang na che?
options: Mara juta kala che.
Mara juta bahu nava che.
Mane nava juta joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mara juta kala che.
questions.translatedSentence: My shoes are black.

questions.sentence: Aa lal sadi mari mummy ni che, mari nathi.
options: This red saree is my mother's, not mine.
This red saree is mine, not my mother's.
My mother does not like this red saree.
questions.correctAnswer: This red saree is my mother's, not mine.

questions.sentence: Aa kalo koat lagna mate barabar rahese?
options: Ha, pan dholo koat vadhare saro lagse.
Ha, lagna kale sanje che.
Na, atyare bahu garmi che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan dholo koat vadhare saro lagse.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but a white coat will look better.

questions.sentence: Me kali topi kadhi ane bhuri topi paheri.
options: I took off the black cap and put on the brown one.
I bought a black cap and a brown cap.
I lost the black cap and the brown cap.
questions.correctAnswer: I took off the black cap and put on the brown one.

questions.sentence: Tamne aa gulabi kurto kevo lage che?
options: Saro che, pan mane gulabi rang nathi gamto.
Ha, mane biju kurto joie che.
Aa kurto mara bhai no che.
questions.correctAnswer: Saro che, pan mane gulabi rang nathi gamto.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nice, but I do not like pink.

questions.sentence: Sabarmati nadi nu paani kaya rang nu dekhay che?
options: Aaje paani thodu bhuru dekhay che.
Nadi ma atyare bahu paani che.
Nadi ahiyan thi bahu duur che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aaje paani thodu bhuru dekhay che.
questions.translatedSentence: Today the water looks a little brown.

questions.sentence: Uttarayan ma aakash ma rangberangi patang ude che.
options: On Uttarayan, colourful kites fly in the sky.
On Uttarayan, we buy colourful kites.
The kites flying in the sky are white.
questions.correctAnswer: On Uttarayan, colourful kites fly in the sky.

questions.sentence: Gir na sinh kaya rang na hoy che?
options: Sinh bhura hoy che.
Sinh kala hoy che.
Sinh Gir na jungle ma rahe che.
questions.correctAnswer: Sinh bhura hoy che.
questions.translatedSentence: Lions are brown.

questions.sentence: Chomasa ma badha khetar lila thai jay che.
options: In the monsoon all the fields turn green.
In the monsoon all the fields fill with water.
The green fields look lovely in the monsoon.
questions.correctAnswer: In the monsoon all the fields turn green.

questions.sentence: Surat ni bus kaya rang ni hoy che?
options: Ahiyan ni bus lal ane dholi hoy che.
Bus have thodi var ma avse.
Hu bus ma Surat javano chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ahiyan ni bus lal ane dholi hoy che.

questions.sentence: Sanje aakash naarangi ane gulabi thai jay che.
options: In the evening the sky turns orange and pink.
In the evening the sky slowly gets dark.
The evening sky is orange but never pink.
questions.correctAnswer: In the evening the sky turns orange and pink.

questions.sentence: Ahmedabad ma rickshaw kaya rang ni hoy che?
options: Ahiyan rickshaw lili ane pili hoy che.
Rickshaw ma javu sastu padse.
Mane rickshaw ma besvu bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ahiyan rickshaw lili ane pili hoy che.
questions.translatedSentence: Here the auto rickshaws are green and yellow.

questions.sentence: Amara gaam ni bajar ma lila ane lal marcha male che.
options: Green and red chillies are sold in our village market.
Our village market sells only green vegetables.
In our village we grow green and red chillies.
questions.correctAnswer: Green and red chillies are sold in our village market.

questions.sentence: Aamba par keri pili thai gai ke nahi?
options: Ha, have badhi keri pili thai gai che.
Na, keri bahu mithi che.
Ha, aamba nu jhaad bahu unchu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, have badhi keri pili thai gai che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, all the mangoes have turned yellow now.

questions.sentence: Aa be ma thi tamne kayo rang vadhare game che?
options: Mane ghero nilo vadhare game che, kem ke e badha kapda saathe sobhe che.
Mane aa banne rang nathi gamta, biju kaik batavo.
Mane aa dukan ni badhi sadio bahu gami.
questions.correctAnswer: Mane ghero nilo vadhare game che, kem ke e badha kapda saathe sobhe che.
questions.translatedSentence: I like the dark blue more, because it goes with all my clothes.

questions.sentence: Jo tamne aa rang ghero lage to hu thodo aachho rang batavu.
options: If this colour seems too dark to you, I will show you a lighter one.
If you like this dark colour, I will bring you two more.
This colour is dark, but I do not have a lighter one.
questions.correctAnswer: If this colour seems too dark to you, I will show you a lighter one.

questions.sentence: Saheb, aa gulabi rang mane sobhe che ke nahi?
options: Ha, aa rang tamne bahu sobhe che, pan aachho gulabi vadhare saro lagse.
Ha, mane pan gulabi rang bahu game che.
Na, aa sadi bahu mongi che, biji joie.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, aa rang tamne bahu sobhe che, pan aachho gulabi vadhare saro lagse.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this colour really suits you, but a lighter pink would look even better.

questions.sentence: Mane pehla lal rang gamto hato, pan have ghero lilo vadhare game che.
options: I used to like red, but now I prefer dark green.
I like red, and I like dark green as well.
I never liked red, so now I choose dark green.
questions.correctAnswer: I used to like red, but now I prefer dark green.

questions.sentence: Tame kayo rang lesho, dholo ke aachho pilo?
options: Hu aachho pilo lais, kem ke dholo jaldi maylo thai jay che.
Hu dholo lais, kem ke mane pilo rang bahu game che.
Hu banne nahi laun, mare atyare kaik biju joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu aachho pilo lais, kem ke dholo jaldi maylo thai jay che.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take the light yellow, because white gets dirty quickly.

questions.sentence: Aa rang saro che, pan mara bhai ne ghera rango vadhare game che.
options: This colour is nice, but my brother likes darker colours more.
This colour is nice, and my brother likes it as well.
My brother says this colour is much too dark.
questions.correctAnswer: This colour is nice, but my brother likes darker colours more.

questions.sentence: Tamne shu lage che, aa be ma thi kayo rang lagna mate saro rahese?
options: Ghero jaambli saro rahese, kem ke photo ma e bahu sundar dekhay che.
Lagna agla mahine Vadodara ma che.
Mane lagna ma navu kaik pahervu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ghero jaambli saro rahese, kem ke photo ma e bahu sundar dekhay che.
questions.translatedSentence: The dark purple will be better, because it looks lovely in photos.

questions.sentence: Mane aa rang to gamyo, pan aa kurto mara size ma nathi.
options: I did like this colour, but this kurta is not in my size.
I liked this colour and luckily this kurta is my size.
I did not like this colour or the size of this kurta.
questions.correctAnswer: I did like this colour, but this kurta is not in my size.

questions.sentence: Bol, tu kayo rang lais?
options: Hu kalo lais, kem ke e badha kapda saathe chale che.
Tu aa rang na le, e tane nathi sobhto.
Mane khabar nathi ke aa rang kyare avse.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu kalo lais, kem ke e badha kapda saathe chale che.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take the black one, because it goes with everything.
